visual_prompt:
PRODUCT: amber dropper bottle with a yellow label (the attached product). It stays in the same zone, size and angle. The brand name and logo printed on its label are softly blurred so no brand can be read; shape, colors and the yellow label stay recognizable.
MAP OF THE IMAGE (fixed, nothing moves):
- Headline: top center: big text '100% ORIGINAL' ('100%' white #FFFFFF, 'ORIGINAL' yellow #F5C518), about 45% of the width, and below it the yellow ribbon with the subtitle (about 40% of the width), all centered. No small brand logo above it.
- Model / before-after: before/after of the same woman in side profile looking at the camera: 'before' on the left and 'after' on the right, each almost full height and about 40% of the width; together about 80% of the image
- Product bottle: amber dropper bottle with yellow label at bottom center, on a stone pedestal with green leaves at its sides; about 55% of the height, front-facing and straight
- Benefit bullets / checks: two labels at mid height over the women: left a red pill with white circle and red X ('before'); right a green pill with white circle and green check ('after')
- Offer block: bottom strip across the width: on the left a yellow block with 'TRATAMIENTO COMPLETO' in big letters; separated by a diagonal bar, on the right a red pill with a white check icon and the text 'RÁPIDO, DURADERO Y SIN EFECTO REBOTE'. No button
- Other blocks: bright yellow curved arrow from before to after above the bottle; white dotted lines next to the left hip and yellow curved sparkles next to the right hip
READING HIERARCHY (unchanged): 1) the before/after contrast with the labels 'GLÚTEOS SIN FORMA' and 'CURVAS MÁS DEFINIDAS'  2) '100% ORIGINAL' on top and the bottle in the center  3) the offer strip at the bottom
AFTER HALF: the same woman, same pose and outfit, with a clearly more curvy lower body: wider hips, thicker and more toned thighs and a more shapely, defined curve at the hips and glutes, natural and believable proportions. The before half stays as it is.
SALES ANGLE (identical): desire: Tener curvas más definidas y una figura que se vea bien en ropa ajustada; main benefit: Fórmula líquida de alta absorción que acompaña el cambio de la figura; pain: Glúteos sin forma.
MODEL: a 27 years old woman, soft, average build, honey-brown skin, shoulder-length brown hair, ordinary and believable (not a fashion model), natural makeup, same woman in both halves.
SETTING: her bedroom at home, unmade bed and soft window light.
POSE AND FRAMING: side profile, standing straight, hands on her hips, knees-up framing.
